name: YT-Zero
description: A self-hosted YouTube inbox for people who want subscriptions, not recommendations. YT Zero reads public YouTube RSS feeds, stores everything locally in SQLite, and provides a calm place to sort, schedule, watch, archive and revisit videos from chosen creators. No Google account, API key or algorithmic home feed is required. The app starts empty; add channels from Settings, then Channels.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database, image cache, avatars, logs and downloaded videos. Back up this directory.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port exposed for the YT Zero web interface.

variables.name: Feed refresh (minutes)
variables.description: How often to poll channel RSS feeds for new videos.

variables.name: Adaptive refresh minimum (minutes)
variables.description: Hard per-channel cooldown for automatic feed polling.

variables.name: Adaptive refresh maximum (minutes)
variables.description: Longest automatic interval before an infrequent channel becomes due.

variables.name: Adaptive refresh unknown cadence (minutes)
variables.description: Polling interval until a channel has enough upload history.

variables.name: Metadata maintenance age (days)
variables.description: Maximum video age considered by automatic Shorts and duration metadata backfills.

variables.name: Idle timeout (seconds)
variables.description: HTTP idle timeout. Manual synchronization can take longer than Bun's default.

variables.name: yt-dlp auto-update
variables.description: Keep the bundled yt-dlp binary updated daily. Only matters when the Downloads plugin is enabled.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: External URL, for example https://ytzero.example.com. Needed for OIDC and passkeys behind a reverse proxy.
